subject: RFP: Commercial model and overage mechanics - Globex Financial
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@globex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@globex.com
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@globex.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Globex RFP - commercial clarifications

Hi Marissa and team,

Thanks for engaging on the RFP. Procurement has a few targeted questions on the commercial/pricing sections before we include Redwood in the short list:

- Please provide a clear committed monthly token model (committed tokens, per-token unit price, what counts as a token for streaming vs embeddings).
- Describe overage mechanics and the step-up/laddered pricing for consumption beyond commit. Are there caps or smoothing options?
- Explain burst credits: how many free burst tokens do you allow, how do they reset, and do they apply separately per model?
- Multi-year discounts / CPI escalators and whether committed credits can be carried between months or quarters (true-up cadence).
- Any separate pricing for private/VPC deployments vs hosted API (heads-up if we need to budget differently).

Would appreciate a short commercial response and a simple TCO example (sample workbook) showing 200M committed tokens/month at your recommended profile. We are on a tight timeline; can you respond by EOD Wednesday 5/12?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Senior Procurement Manager
Globex Financial

--
Note: attaching the RFP reference in our system (RFP# GLX-2026-RFP-07)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@globex.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@globex.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Globex RFP - commercial clarifications
Attachments: Globex_RFP_Commercial_Response_20260512.pdf (pdf), sample_tco_globex_200M.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear list. Attached is our commercial response and a worked example workbook for a 200M token/month profile. Summary below (high-level; details in attached PDF):

1) Committed model (monthly):
- Committed bands (examples): 50M, 200M, 1B tokens/month.
- Base per-token rates (text gen; 8k context): 50M tier = $0.0011/token; 200M tier = $0.00085/token; 1B tier = $0.0006/token.
- Embeddings tokens are priced at 60% of text gen rate by default (we can further separate if you require).

2) Overage mechanics:
- Monthly overage billed at stepped rates (see attached). Example ladder for 200M commit:
  * 0–10% over commit: $0.00095/token
  * 10–50% over commit: $0.00115/token
  * >50% over commit: $0.00145/token
- We offer optional smoothing on request (3-month rolling true-up) to reduce monthly volatility.
- There is a hard cap option available if you need strict budget limits; that converts overages to throttles after a threshold.

3) Burst credits:
- Standard offering: 10% of committed tokens available as free burst credits each month (non-cumulative; resets each month).
- For customers who need predictable burst behavior, we can allocate burst as instantaneous pool or distributed per-model.

4) True-up and carry:
- Default cadence: quarterly true-up (billed/credited on next invoice). Annual true-up can be enabled for enterprise contracts.
- Carryover is limited: unused committed tokens do not carry month-to-month, but in 3-year deals we can allow limited carryover between quarters and an annual carry-forward of up to 5% if negotiated.

5) Multi-year pricing and escalators:
- 1-year: standard rates above.
- 2-year: additional 8% effective discount on published rates (applies to base committed price only).
- 3-year: up to 15% discount + optional fixed CPI cap (max 3% annual escalation).

6) Private/VPC pricing:
- Private deployments have a platform fee (one-time) + adjusted per-token runtime surcharge to cover host infra and networking. Typical delta: +18–25% on per-token rates depending on isolation level and third-party licensing. Exact numbers included in the attached appendix.

Other commercial notes:
- One-time onboarding credit available: $25,000 credit on the first invoice for contracts >= 12 months.
- Marketplace/partner credit: 5% offset if we route through a listed partner (helps with procurement workflows).
- SLA & SLA credits available for Dedicated customers (see Terms appendix).

Next steps: happy to walk through the workbook over a 30–45m call. Proposed times: Wed 5/12 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 5/13 08:00–10:00 PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@globex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@globex.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2026 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Globex RFP - commercial clarifications

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the workbook, that helped. A couple follow-ups from procurement and our cloud team:

- Can you confirm whether overage ladder applies across model families or per-model? (We use both large chat models and smaller embedding models heavily.)
- Does the 10% monthly burst apply separately to embeddings and text gen, or is it a single pool?
- For EU-bound traffic/data residency, if we request a private VPC in eu-west-1, does the Surcharge still apply at the same rate? Any minimums for private deployments?
- Finally: can you provide a capped overage option that limits total monthly spend to commit + 25% (we would accept throttling beyond that)? If available, what is the pricing trade-off?

If possible, include a short sample calc showing: commit = 200M tokens, actual usage = 260M (30% over) with 20% of that usage as embeddings.

Thanks — Tom
IT Procurement
Globex Financial

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@globex.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Globex RFP - commercial clarifications
Attachments: redline_commercial_terms_globex.docx (docx)

Tom — great questions. Short answers first, then a worked calculation inline. We can follow up with a call to step through the workbook.

1) Overage ladder: applies at the tenant level (aggregate across model families) by default. If you require per-model ladders we can scope that as an add-on and it would add a small complexity surcharge.

2) Burst credits: configurable. Default is a single pool per tenant, but we can partition by model class (text vs embeddings) if you want predictable embedding capacity.

3) EU private: surcharge applies (same percent range) but minimums are typically higher due to reserved capacity (example: minimum quarterly commit for EU private deployments = 150M tokens equivalent). We'll include an EU appendix with exact numbers.

4) Capped overage option: yes — we offer a capped plan where we set an overage ceiling (e.g., commit + 25%). Trade-off: higher per-token overage rate in the capped band but guaranteed spend ceiling. Example for 200M commit with 25% cap:
  * Commit: 200,000,000 tokens @ $0.00085 = $170,000
  * Usage: 260,000,000 tokens (30% over) -> capped at 250,000,000 (25% over) if you select cap; excess 10M get throttled.
  * Overage pricing under capped plan (example): flat $0.00105/token for any overage up to cap.
  * Effective monthly invoice: $170,000 + (50,000,000 * $0.00105) = $170,000 + $52,500 = $222,500

Worked calc for your ask (no cap, aggregate ladder, 20% embeddings):
  * Commit: 200,000,000 tokens (base mix assumed: 80% text, 20% embeddings)
  * Actual usage: 260,000,000 tokens (20% embeddings => 52,000,000 embeddings; 208,000,000 text)
  * Chargeable tokens (normalized): embeddings billed at 60% of text rate. For simplicity: convert embeddings effective cost = 52M * 0.6 = 31.2M equivalent text tokens. Total equivalent text tokens = 208M + 31.2M = 239.2M
  * Over-equivalent = 239.2M - 200M = 39.2M (≈19.6% over equivalent) -> falls in 10–50% ladder band.
  * Overage band price (10–50%): $0.00115/token -> overage charge = 39.2M * $0.00115 ≈ $45,080
  * Base committed charge = 200M * $0.00085 = $170,000
  * Total = $215,080 (before taxes/fees).

We have included these worked numbers in the attached workbook and PDF with line-item transparency.

Legal/terms note (Neha): the capped overage and EU private minimums will need SOW language; included a draft in the redline attachment.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 512-555-0103

Quick internal — thanks Ben, the worked calc looks good. Approve presenting both: (A) standard laddered overage option + 10% monthly burst, and (B) capped-overage option (commit + 25% with flat overage) as alternate.

Karthik — please confirm finance is comfortable with the illustrative $0.00105 capped overage level for 200M commits (I used conservative margin).
Neha — please mark redline doc as "ready for SOW" and prepare SOW template for EU private minimums.

If we get buy-in from Globex on the capped option, we'll include onboarding credit ($25k) and a 12-month payment cadence with quarterly true-up.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
